title: Hunts FH-043T: Split or hold a finished Expedition team's reward

source.ref: Split from FH-043S (2026-11-18): the team panel and scan hand-off shipped dark; the reward and database halves move here.

detail: Owed after FH-043S. (1) Game systems: nothing calls allocateTeamAward (lib/hunts/teams.ts, hunt_team_award_allocate) yet, and hunt_reward_grant still grants a finished team run's reward to the captain. Decide per reward whether the team holds one unit or a split, and call the allocation where the grant lands. (2) Database owner: migration 20270346082000_hunt_teams_editions.sql was applied in production 2026-11-17; confirm supabase/tests/hunt_teams.test.sql passes in db-tests, and check by hand with two sessions that two members claiming one stop queue on the team row lock. (3) Owner ruled 2026-11-18: Expedition teammates see each other's first names only. Build the roster to that rule (docs/hunts/ROLE-MATRIX.md has no roster view; the panel shows a count only). (4) A design look at components/hunts/team-panel.tsx. Done when: a finished team's reward lands per the owner's rule through hunt_team_award_allocate. Requires: FH-043S. Owner role: Game systems, with the database owner. Hunts switches stay OFF.
